                    engineOrder: this.activeOrderFromState(),
                    restrained: globalTime < this.restraintUntil
                };
            },
            maybeMilestoneChat(snapshot) {
                let gemmaOwnsChat = NativeGemma.ownsVisibleChat();
                if (gameState.player.age !== this.lastPlayerAge) {
                    this.lastPlayerAge = gameState.player.age;
                    let line = `You reached ${AGES[gameState.player.age].name}. I am updating the counter-plan.`;
                    if (!gemmaOwnsChat) DirectorPanel.add('ai', line);
                    GemmaMemory.recordSystem(line);
                }
                if (gameState.enemy.age !== this.lastEnemyAge) {
                    this.lastEnemyAge = gameState.enemy.age;
                    DirectorPanel.showAction('evolve_enemy', AGES[gameState.enemy.age].name);
                    GemmaMemory.recordSystem(`Enemy evolved to ${AGES[gameState.enemy.age].name}.`);
                }
                if (snapshot.enemyHpRatio < 0.25 && !this.lowHpWarned) {
                    this.lowHpWarned = true;
                    let line = 'My base is down to the margin. Expect defensive spending.';
                    if (!gemmaOwnsChat) DirectorPanel.add('ai', line);
                    GemmaMemory.recordSystem(line);
                }
            },
            comment(snapshot) {
                if (NativeGemma.ownsVisibleChat()) return;
                let a = DirectorMemory.data.agreements;
                let order = this.activeOrderFromState();
                let orderLines = {
                    press: ['I am keeping the lane busy; quiet gold is wasted pressure.', 'Your front is too far out. I am forcing contact.'],
                    defend: ['You are close enough that I have to stabilize before I swing back.', 'Base first, counterpush second. I am buying time.'],
                    counter: ['I am reading your unit mix and changing the answer, not just spamming.', 'That composition has a weakness. I am moving into the counter.'],
                    tech: ['I can afford a slower minute, so I am turning it into economy and age timing.', 'You gave me room; I am converting it into tech.'],
                    swarm: ['I am not waiting for a perfect unit. I am filling the lane now.', 'Cheap bodies first; the timing matters more than elegance.'],
                    heavy: ['I am holding enough gold for a heavier hit.', 'The next swing is being banked, not missed.'],
                    hold: ['I am not spending into a bad trade unless you force me.', 'I am letting the position breathe until there is a better punish.'],
                    fortify: ['I am turning the right side into a harder target.', 'You will have to pay for every step near my base.'],
                    special: ['I am watching for the special timing, not wasting it early.', 'If you stack too tightly, I have the clear ready.']
                };
                let lines = orderLines[order] || [];
                if (lines.length && this.lastCommentKey !== order) {
                    this.lastCommentKey = order;
                    DirectorPanel.add('ai', lines[Math.floor(Math.random() * lines.length)]);
                    return;
                }
                if (snapshot.restrained) {
                    DirectorPanel.add('ai', 'Truce timer is still active. I am using the quiet turns for upgrades.');
                } else if (a.noSpecials || a.noTurrets || a.meleeOnly) {
                    DirectorPanel.add('ai', `Pacts still active: ${DirectorMemory.tags().join(', ')}.`);
                } else if (snapshot.threatCount >= 4) {
                    DirectorPanel.add('ai', 'Your line is stacked near my base. I am spending defensively.');
                } else if (snapshot.pressure === 'rush') {
                    DirectorPanel.add('ai', 'You asked for pressure, so I am converting gold into bodies.');
                } else if (snapshot.pressure === 'mercy') {
                    DirectorPanel.add('ai', 'Mercy plan is on. I will not flood the lane while you are behind.');
                } else {
                    DirectorPanel.add('ai', 'I am watching age timing, gold float, and front-line distance.');
                }
            },
            chooseAction(snapshot) {
                if (this.tryEvolve()) return;
                this.updateLocalOrder(snapshot);
                snapshot.engineOrder = this.activeOrderFromState();
                let order = snapshot.engineOrder || 'balanced';

                if (snapshot.restrained && snapshot.threatCount < 2) {
                    if (this.tryUpgrade('econ', 'truce economy')) return;
                    if (this.tryUpgrade('hp', 'truce fortify')) return;
                    return;
                }

                if (this.tryEmergencyAction(snapshot)) return;
                if (this.tryHumanTimingHold(order, snapshot)) return;
                if (this.tryOrderAction(order, snapshot)) return;
                if (this.tryBestScoredAction(order, snapshot)) return;
                if (this.tryCounterUnit(snapshot, 'fallback counter read')) return;
                if (this.tryPressureUnit(snapshot, 'fallback lane presence')) return;
                this.holdAction('saving for a better human-like trade');
            },
            tryHumanTimingHold(order, snapshot) {
                let ai = gameState.enemy;
                let ageData = AGES[ai.age];
                if (!ageData) return false;
                let heavy = ageData.units[2];
                let support = ageData.units[1];
                let profile = this.emotionProfile();
                if (snapshot.threatCount >= 3 || snapshot.enemyHpRatio < 0.38) return false;
                if ((this.macroPlan === 'bankHeavy' || order === 'heavy' || (snapshot.playerRanged > snapshot.playerMelee && snapshot.frontGap > 280)) &&
                    heavy && ai.gold >= heavy.cost * 0.58 && ai.gold < heavy.cost) {
                    return this.holdAction('banking for heavy counter timing');
                }
                if (this.macroPlan === 'techWindow' && snapshot.threatCount < 2) {
                    let econLevel = ai.upgrades.econ || 0;
                    let econCost = econLevel < 10 ? UPGRADE_COSTS[econLevel] : Infinity;
                    if (ai.gold >= econCost * 0.62 && ai.gold < econCost) return this.holdAction('waiting for economy upgrade');
                }
                if (this.lastSpawnType === 2 && globalTime - this.lastSpawnAt < 4.5 && support && ai.gold >= support.cost && snapshot.enemyUnits <= snapshot.playerUnits + 1) {
                    return this.trySpawnUnit(1, 'human follow-up support after heavy');
                }
                if (profile.patience > 0.35 && snapshot.enemyUnits >= snapshot.playerUnits + 1 && snapshot.frontGap > 430 && Math.random() < 0.35) {
                    return this.holdAction('not overcommitting into open lane');
                }
                return false;
            },
            tryBestScoredAction(order, snapshot) {
                let ai = gameState.enemy;
                let ageData = AGES[ai.age];
                if (!ageData) return false;
                let profile = this.emotionProfile();
                let candidates = [];
                let add = (kind, score, reason, run) => {
                    if (!Number.isFinite(score)) return;
                    candidates.push({ kind, score: score + Math.random() * 0.08, reason, run });
                };

                if (!DirectorMemory.data.agreements.noSpecials && ai.specialTimer <= 0 && !gameState.specialActive) {
                    add('special', this.scoreSpecial(snapshot, order, profile), 'scored special timing', () => this.trySpecial('scored special timing'));
                }
                if (!DirectorMemory.data.agreements.noTurrets) {
                    let openSlot = ai.turrets.some((slot, idx) => slot === null && idx < ai.unlockedSlots);
                    let canSlot = ai.unlockedSlots < 4 && ai.gold >= ai.unlockedSlots * 500;
                    if (openSlot || canSlot) add('turret', this.scoreTurret(snapshot, order, profile), 'scored base defense', () => this.tryBuildTurret('scored base defense'));
                }
                ['econ', 'dmg', 'hp'].forEach(type => {
                    let lvl = ai.upgrades[type] || 0;
                    if (lvl < 10 && ai.gold >= UPGRADE_COSTS[lvl]) {
                        add(`upgrade:${type}`, this.scoreUpgrade(type, snapshot, order, profile), `scored ${type} upgrade`, () => this.tryUpgrade(type, `scored ${type} upgrade`));
                    }
                });
                for (let i = 0; i < ageData.units.length; i++) {
                    let unit = ageData.units[i];
                    if (!unit || ai.gold < unit.cost) continue;
                    if (DirectorMemory.data.agreements.meleeOnly && unit.type === 'ranged') continue;
                    add(`unit:${unit.name}`, this.scoreUnitType(i, snapshot, order, profile), `scored ${unit.name}`, () => this.trySpawnUnit(i, `scored ${unit.name}`));
                }
                add('hold', this.scoreHold(snapshot, order, profile), 'scored patience', () => this.holdAction('scored patience'));
                candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
                let best = candidates[0];
                if (!best || best.score < 0.15) return false;
                return best.run();
            },
            scoreUnitType(typeIdx, snapshot, order, profile) {
                let unit = AGES[gameState.enemy.age].units[typeIdx];
                if (!unit) return -999;
                let score = 0.25 + currentConfig.aiAggression * 0.45 + profile.aggression * 0.8 - profile.patience * 0.18;
                let countNeed = Math.max(0, snapshot.playerUnits - snapshot.enemyUnits);
                score += Math.min(1.7, countNeed * 0.34);
                if (order === 'swarm' && typeIdx === 0) score += 1.1;
                if (order === 'press') score += typeIdx === 2 ? 0.65 : 0.35;
                if (order === 'heavy' && typeIdx === 2) score += 1.55;
                if (order === 'defend' && snapshot.threatCount > 0) score += typeIdx === 0 ? 0.6 : 0.35;
                if (order === 'counter') score += 0.45;
                if (this.macroPlan === 'punishRanged') score += unit.type === 'heavy' ? 1.4 : (unit.type === 'melee' ? -0.9 : 0.15);
                if (this.macroPlan === 'screenHeavy') score += unit.type === 'ranged' ? 1.25 : (unit.type === 'heavy' ? -0.45 : 0.25);
                if (this.macroPlan === 'flood') score += typeIdx === 0 ? 0.9 : 0.25;
                if (this.macroPlan === 'killPush') score += unit.type === 'heavy' ? 0.9 : 0.35;
                if (this.macroPlan === 'stabilize') score += unit.type === 'melee' ? 0.65 : 0.25;
                if (snapshot.playerRanged > snapshot.playerMelee && unit.type === 'melee' && snapshot.closestThreatDist > 180) score -= 2.4;
                if (snapshot.playerRanged > snapshot.playerMelee && unit.type === 'heavy') score += 1.85;
                if (snapshot.playerHeavy > 0 && unit.type === 'ranged') score += 1.35;
                if (snapshot.playerMelee >= snapshot.playerRanged + 2 && unit.type === 'ranged') score += 0.9;
                if (snapshot.heavyThreat && unit.type === 'ranged') score += 1.1;
                if (snapshot.threatCount >= 3 && unit.type === 'heavy' && snapshot.enemyGold < unit.cost * 1.8) score -= 0.7;
                if (snapshot.playerHpRatio < 0.36 && unit.type === 'heavy' && snapshot.pressure !== 'mercy') score += 1.1;
                if (snapshot.pressure === 'mercy' && snapshot.playerHpRatio < 0.5) score -= unit.type === 'heavy' ? 1.5 : 0.6;
                if (snapshot.playerTurretCount >= 2 && unit.type !== 'heavy' && snapshot.frontGap > 480) score -= 0.55;
                if (snapshot.playerTurretCount >= 2 && unit.type === 'heavy') score += 0.45;
                if (this.lastSpawnType === typeIdx) score -= Math.min(0.8, this.spawnStreak * 0.22);
                if (unit.type === 'melee' && snapshot.enemyMelee > snapshot.enemyRanged + 2 && snapshot.playerRanged > 0) score -= 0.6;
                return score;
            },
            scoreUpgrade(type, snapshot, order, profile) {
                let ai = gameState.enemy;
                let lvl = ai.upgrades[type] || 0;
                let score = 0.2 - lvl * 0.05;
                if (type === 'econ') {
                    score += 1.1 + profile.tech + profile.patience * 0.5;
                    if (snapshot.threatCount > 2) score -= 1.6;
                    if (order === 'tech' || order === 'hold') score += 0.8;
                    if (gameState.player.age > ai.age) score += 0.45;
                    if (this.macroPlan === 'techWindow') score += 0.85;
                    if (this.macroPlan === 'killPush' || this.macroPlan === 'flood') score -= 0.65;
                } else if (type === 'dmg') {
                    score += 0.65 + snapshot.enemyUnits * 0.12 + profile.aggression * 0.55;
                    if (order === 'press' || order === 'counter' || order === 'swarm') score += 0.5;
                    if (snapshot.playerUnits >= 3) score += 0.35;
                    if (snapshot.playerTurretCount >= 2 || this.macroPlan === 'killPush') score += 0.45;
                } else if (type === 'hp') {
                    score += (1 - snapshot.enemyHpRatio) * 1.8 + snapshot.threatCount * 0.24 + profile.caution * 0.9;
                    if (order === 'defend' || order === 'fortify') score += 0.7;
                    if (this.macroPlan === 'stabilize' || this.macroPlan === 'fortify') score += 0.5;
                }
                if (globalTime - this.lastUpgradeAt < 3.5) score -= 0.45;
                return score;
            },
            scoreTurret(snapshot, order, profile) {
                let score = 0.2 + profile.caution * 1.0;
                score += snapshot.threatCount * 0.35 + Math.max(0, 0.62 - snapshot.enemyHpRatio) * 1.3;
                if (order === 'defend' || order === 'fortify') score += 1.0;
                if (snapshot.closestThreatDist < 420) score += 0.9;
                if (snapshot.threatCount === 0 && profile.aggression > 0.2) score -= 0.6;
                if (this.macroPlan === 'fortify' || this.macroPlan === 'stabilize') score += 0.8;
                if (this.macroPlan === 'killPush' || this.macroPlan === 'flood') score -= 0.45;
                return score;
            },
            scoreSpecial(snapshot, order, profile) {
                let score = -0.2 + profile.special + profile.volatility * 0.25;
                if (snapshot.threatCount >= 5) score += 2.2;
                if (snapshot.heavyThreat && snapshot.threatCount >= 2) score += 1.4;
                if (snapshot.playerUnits >= 5) score += 0.9;
                if (snapshot.playerHpRatio < 0.45 && snapshot.pressure !== 'mercy') score += 0.5;
                if (order === 'special') score += 1.0;
                if (this.macroPlan === 'killPush') score += 0.55;
                if (this.macroPlan === 'techWindow' && snapshot.threatCount < 3) score -= 0.55;
                return score;
            },
            scoreHold(snapshot, order, profile) {
                let score = 0.05 + profile.patience * 0.8;
                if (order === 'hold' || order === 'tech' || order === 'heavy') score += 0.45;
                if (snapshot.threatCount > 1) score -= 1.4;
                if (snapshot.enemyUnits < snapshot.playerUnits) score -= 0.8;
                if (snapshot.pressure === 'mercy' && snapshot.playerHpRatio < 0.5) score += 1.2;
                if (this.macroPlan === 'bankHeavy' || this.macroPlan === 'techWindow') score += 0.5;
                if (this.macroPlan === 'killPush' || this.macroPlan === 'flood') score -= 0.9;
                return score;
            },
            tryEmergencyAction(snapshot) {
                if ((snapshot.threatCount >= 6 || (snapshot.heavyThreat && snapshot.threatCount >= 2)) && this.trySpecial('emergency clear')) return true;
                if (snapshot.threatCount >= 3 && this.tryBuildTurret('live base defense')) return true;
                if (snapshot.enemyHpRatio < 0.45 && this.tryUpgrade('hp', 'live base stabilize')) return true;
                if (snapshot.threatCount >= 2 && snapshot.enemyUnits < snapshot.playerUnits && this.tryCounterUnit(snapshot, 'live counter near base')) return true;
                return false;
            },
            tryOrderAction(order, snapshot) {
                let ai = gameState.enemy;
                let ageData = AGES[ai.age];
                if (!ageData) return false;

                if (order === 'defend') {
                    if (snapshot.threatCount >= 3 && this.trySpecial('order defend clear')) return true;
                    if (this.tryBuildTurret('order defend turret')) return true;
                    if (this.tryUpgrade('hp', 'order defend hp')) return true;
                    if (this.tryCounterUnit(snapshot, 'order defend counter')) return true;
                    if (this.trySpawnUnit(0, 'order defend blocker')) return true;
                    return false;
                }

                if (order === 'fortify') {
                    if (this.tryBuildTurret('order fortify turret')) return true;
                    if (this.tryUpgrade('hp', 'order fortify hp')) return true;
                    if (snapshot.threatCount < 2 && this.tryUpgrade('econ', 'order fortify income')) return true;
                    if (snapshot.enemyUnits < snapshot.playerUnits + 1 && this.trySpawnUnit(1, 'order fortify cover')) return true;
                    return false;
                }

                if (order === 'counter') {
                    if (this.tryCounterUnit(snapshot, 'order counter unit mix')) return true;
                    if (this.tryUpgrade('dmg', 'order counter damage')) return true;
                    return false;
                }

                if (order === 'tech') {
                    let ecoTarget = Math.min(10, 3 + Math.floor(currentConfig.aiAggression * 5));
                    if (snapshot.threatCount < 3 && ai.upgrades.econ < ecoTarget && this.tryUpgrade('econ', 'order tech economy')) return true;
                    if (snapshot.threatCount < 2 && this.tryUpgrade('dmg', 'order tech damage')) return true;
                    if (snapshot.enemyUnits < Math.max(1, Math.floor(snapshot.playerUnits * 0.7)) && this.trySpawnUnit(1, 'order tech screen')) return true;
                    return this.holdAction('order tech patience');
                }

                if (order === 'press') {
                    if (snapshot.playerHpRatio < 0.35 && this.trySpawnUnit(2, 'order press finisher')) return true;
                    if (this.tryPressureUnit(snapshot, 'order press')) return true;
                    if (this.tryUpgrade('dmg', 'order press damage')) return true;
                    return false;
                }

                if (order === 'swarm') {
                    if (snapshot.playerRanged > snapshot.playerMelee && this.trySpawnUnit(2, 'order swarm punish ranged')) return true;
                    if (snapshot.playerHeavy > 0 && this.trySpawnUnit(1, 'order swarm screen heavy')) return true;
                    if (this.trySpawnUnit(0, 'order swarm body')) return true;
                    if (this.trySpawnUnit(1, 'order swarm ranged')) return true;
                    if (this.tryUpgrade('dmg', 'order swarm damage')) return true;
                    return false;
                }

                if (order === 'heavy') {
                    if (this.trySpawnUnit(2, 'order heavy power unit')) return true;
                    if (snapshot.threatCount > 0 && this.tryCounterUnit(snapshot, 'order heavy safety screen')) return true;
                    if (snapshot.enemyUnits < Math.max(1, snapshot.playerUnits) && this.trySpawnUnit(0, 'order heavy cheap screen')) return true;
                    return this.holdAction('saving for heavy unit');
                }

                if (order === 'special') {
                    if ((snapshot.threatCount >= 2 || snapshot.playerUnits >= 3 || snapshot.playerHpRatio < 0.55) && this.trySpecial('order special timing')) return true;
                    if (snapshot.threatCount >= 1 && this.tryBuildTurret('order special setup defense')) return true;
                    if (this.tryPressureUnit(snapshot, 'order special setup pressure')) return true;
                    return false;
                }

                if (order === 'hold') {
                    if (snapshot.threatCount >= 2 && this.tryCounterUnit(snapshot, 'order hold necessary answer')) return true;
                    if (snapshot.threatCount < 2 && this.tryUpgrade('econ', 'order hold quiet economy')) return true;
                    return this.holdAction('holding for better trade');
                }

                return false;
            },
            tryPressureUnit(snapshot, reason) {
                if (snapshot.threatCount < 4 && snapshot.enemyGold >= AGES[gameState.enemy.age].units[2].cost && this.trySpawnUnit(2, `${reason} heavy`)) return true;
                if (snapshot.playerRanged > snapshot.playerMelee && this.trySpawnUnit(2, `${reason} crush ranged`)) return true;
                if (this.trySpawnUnit(1, `${reason} support`)) return true;
                if (this.trySpawnUnit(0, `${reason} filler`)) return true;
                return false;
            },
            tryCounterUnit(snapshot, reason) {
                if (snapshot.heavyThreat && this.trySpawnUnit(1, `${reason} anti-heavy range`)) return true;
                if (snapshot.playerRanged > snapshot.playerMelee && this.trySpawnUnit(2, `${reason} punish ranged`)) return true;
                if (snapshot.playerHeavy > 0 && this.trySpawnUnit(1, `${reason} kite heavy`)) return true;
                if (snapshot.playerUnits > snapshot.enemyUnits + 1 && this.trySpawnUnit(1, `${reason} match count`)) return true;
                if (snapshot.playerUnits > snapshot.enemyUnits && this.trySpawnUnit(0, `${reason} cheap body`)) return true;
                if (this.trySpawnUnit(1, `${reason} default cover`)) return true;
                if (this.trySpawnUnit(0, `${reason} default blocker`)) return true;
                return false;
            },
            holdAction(reason) {
                if (globalTime - this.lastPlanNoticeAt > 5) {
                    this.reportSignal('hold', reason);
                    this.lastPlanNoticeAt = globalTime;
                }
                return true;
            },
            tryEvolve() {
                let ai = gameState.enemy;
                if (ai.age >= AGES.length - 1 || ai.xp < AGES[ai.age].evolveXP) return false;
                ai.age++;
                ai.drawProgress = 0;
                let newMax = AGES[ai.age].baseHp * currentConfig.baseHpMult * getStatMult(ai, 'hp');
                ai.hp += (newMax - ai.maxHp);
                ai.maxHp = newMax;
                ai.turrets = [null, null, null, null];
                ai.turretTimers = [0, 0, 0, 0];
                this.lastEnemyAge = ai.age;
                this.reportSignal('age', AGES[ai.age].name, true);
                return true;
            },
            tryUpgrade(type, reason) {
                let ai = gameState.enemy;
                let lvl = ai.upgrades[type];
                if (lvl >= 10) return false;
                let cost = UPGRADE_COSTS[lvl];
                if (ai.gold < cost) return false;
                ai.gold -= cost;
                ai.upgrades[type]++;
                if (type === 'hp') {
                    let newMax = AGES[ai.age].baseHp * currentConfig.baseHpMult * getStatMult(ai, 'hp');
                    ai.hp += (newMax - ai.maxHp);
                    ai.maxHp = newMax;
                }
                this.reportSignal(`upgrade:${type}`, reason);
                this.lastUpgradeAt = globalTime;
                return true;
            },
            tryBuildTurret(reason) {
                let a = DirectorMemory.data.agreements;
                if (a.noTurrets) return false;
                let ai = gameState.enemy;
                let emptySlot = ai.turrets.findIndex((t, idx) => t === null && idx < ai.unlockedSlots);
                if (emptySlot === -1) {
                    let slotCost = ai.unlockedSlots * 500;
                    if (ai.unlockedSlots < 4 && ai.gold >= slotCost) {
                        ai.gold -= slotCost;
                        ai.unlockedSlots++;
                        this.reportSignal('fort:slot', reason);
                        return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                }

                let ageData = AGES[ai.age];
                let typeIdx = this.bestTurretIndex(ageData, ai.gold);
                let cost = ageData.turrets[typeIdx].cost;
                if (ai.gold < cost) return false;
                ai.gold -= cost;
                ai.turrets[emptySlot] = typeIdx;
                ai.turretProgress[emptySlot] = 0;
                this.reportSignal(`fort:${ageData.turrets[typeIdx].name}`, reason);
                return true;
            },
            bestTurretIndex(ageData, gold) {
                let snapshot = this.snapshot();
                let best = 0;
                let bestScore = -Infinity;
                for (let i = 0; i < ageData.turrets.length; i++) {
                    let turret = ageData.turrets[i];
                    if (!turret || gold < turret.cost) continue;
                    let dps = turret.dmg / Math.max(0.1, turret.attackSpeed || 1);
                    let score = dps * 0.018 + turret.range * 0.004 - turret.cost / Math.max(1, gold) * 0.25;
                    if (snapshot.threatCount >= 3) score += dps * 0.012;
                    if (snapshot.closestThreatDist < 340 && turret.range >= 300) score += 0.7;
                    if (snapshot.playerHeavy > 0) score += turret.dmg * 0.004;
                    if (snapshot.playerRanged > snapshot.playerMelee) score += turret.range * 0.002;
                    if (currentConfig.aiAggression > 0.7 && i === 2) score += 0.35;
                    if (score > bestScore) {
                        bestScore = score;
                        best = i;
                    }
                }
                return best;
            },
            trySpecial(reason) {
                let a = DirectorMemory.data.agreements;
                let ai = gameState.enemy;
                if (a.noSpecials || ai.specialTimer > 0 || gameState.specialActive) return false;
                triggerSpecial(-1);
                ai.specialTimer = AGES[ai.age].special.cooldown;
                this.reportSignal(`special:${AGES[ai.age].special.name}`, reason, true);
                return true;
            },
            trySpawnUnit(typeIdx, reason) {
                let a = DirectorMemory.data.agreements;
                let ai = gameState.enemy;
                let data = AGES[ai.age].units[typeIdx];
                if (!data) return false;
                if (a.meleeOnly && data.type === 'ranged') return false;
                if (globalTime < this.restraintUntil && reason.indexOf('answer') === -1 && reason.indexOf('stall') === -1) return false;
                if (ai.gold < data.cost) return false;
                ai.gold -= data.cost;
                spawnUnit(-1, ai.age, typeIdx);
                if (this.lastSpawnType === typeIdx && globalTime - this.lastSpawnAt < 7) this.spawnStreak++;
                else this.spawnStreak = 1;
                this.lastSpawnType = typeIdx;
                this.lastSpawnAt = globalTime;
                this.reportSignal(`unit:${data.name}`, reason);
                return true;
            },
            reportSignal(name, reason, force = false) {
                if (force || globalTime - this.lastActionNoticeAt > 1.8) {
                    DirectorPanel.showAction(name, reason);
                    if (force || /special|evolve|age/i.test(name)) {
                        GemmaMemory.recordSystem(`Engine signal ${name}: ${reason}`);
                    }
                    this.lastActionNoticeAt = globalTime;
                }
            }
        };

        // --- OBJECT POOL ARCHITECTURE (ZERO-GC GAMEPLAY) ---
        class ObjectPool {
            constructor(maxSize, factory) {
                this.factory = factory;
                this.pool = new Array(maxSize);
                for (let i = 0; i < maxSize; i++) { this.pool[i] = factory(); this.pool[i].active = false; }
            }
            spawn(props) {
                for (let i = 0; i < this.pool.length; i++) {
                    if (!this.pool[i].active) {
                        let obj = this.pool[i];
                        for (let k in props) obj[k] = props[k];
                        obj.active = true; return obj;
                    }
                }
                // Expand dynamically if impossible limits hit.
                let obj = this.factory();
                for (let k in props) obj[k] = props[k];
                obj.active = true; this.pool.push(obj);
                return obj;
            }
        }

        // --- GAME ENGINE STATE ---
        let gameState = {};
        let globalIdSequence = 0;
        let lastTime = 0;
        let globalTime = 0;
        let currentTab = 'units';

        // Pre-allocate large physics arrays to avoid GC
        let physicsAllies = new Array(500); let physicsAlliesCount = 0;
        let physicsEnemies = new Array(500); let physicsEnemiesCount = 0;

        // --- SQUIGGLEVISION MAGIC ---
        function jitterVal(x, y, amp) {
            let frame = Math.floor(globalTime * 8) % 3;
            let seed = x * 12.9898 + y * 78.233 + frame * 13.131;
            let h = Math.sin(seed) * 43758.5453;
            return ((h - Math.floor(h)) - 0.5) * amp;
        }

        function setSketchStyle(color, thickness = 2) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = color;
            ctx.fillStyle = color;
            ctx.lineWidth = thickness;
            ctx.lineCap = 'round';
            ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        }

        function applyDash(progress, pathLen) {
            if (progress >= 1.0) { ctx.setLineDash([]); return; }
            let dash = pathLen;
            ctx.setLineDash([dash, dash]);
            ctx.lineDashOffset = dash * (1.0 - progress);
        }

        function drawRoughLine(x1, y1, x2, y2, passes = 2, jAmp = 3, progress = 1.0) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            let len = Math.sqrt((x2 - x1) ** 2 + (y2 - y1) ** 2);
            for (let i = 0; i < passes; i++) {
                let ox1 = x1 + jitterVal(x1, y1 + i, jAmp);
                let oy1 = y1 + jitterVal(x1 + i, y1, jAmp);
                let ox2 = x2 + jitterVal(x2, y2 + i, jAmp);
                let oy2 = y2 + jitterVal(x2 + i, y2, jAmp);
                ctx.moveTo(ox1, oy1);
                let mx = (x1 + x2) / 2 + jitterVal((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2 + i, jAmp * 2);
                let my = (y1 + y2) / 2 + jitterVal((x1 + x2) / 2 + i, (y1 + y2) / 2, jAmp * 2);
                ctx.quadraticCurveTo(mx, my, ox2, oy2);
            }
            applyDash(progress, len);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
        }

        function drawRoughCircle(cx, cy, r, passes = 2, jAmp = 3, progress = 1.0) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            let len = 2 * Math.PI * r;
            for (let i = 0; i < passes; i++) {
                let jc_x = cx + jitterVal(cx, cy + i, jAmp);
                let jc_y = cy + jitterVal(cx + i, cy, jAmp);
                let jr = r + jitterVal(r, i, jAmp);
                ctx.arc(jc_x, jc_y, jr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            }
            applyDash(progress, len * passes);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
        }

        function fillScribble(x, y, w, h, color, density = 5, progress = 1.0) {
            if (progress <= 0) return;
            ctx.strokeStyle = color;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.beginPath();
            let totalLines = Math.floor(w / density);
            let linesToDraw = Math.max(1, Math.floor(totalLines * progress));
            for (let i = 0; i <= linesToDraw; i++) {
                let cx = x + (i * density);
                let j1 = jitterVal(cx, y, 5);
                let j2 = jitterVal(cx, y + h, 5);
                ctx.moveTo(cx + j1, y + Math.abs(j1));
                ctx.lineTo(cx + j2, y + h - Math.abs(j2));
            }
            ctx.stroke();
        }

        // --- BOOTSTRAP INITIALIZATION ---
        window.onload = () => {
            UIManager.init();
            TooltipManager.init();
            StorageManager.init();
            DirectorMemory.init();
            GemmaMemory.init();
            DirectorPanel.init();
            NativeGemma.init();

            // Async generation of heavy procedural assets
            WatercolorEngine.generateAll().then(() => {
                document.getElementById('preloader').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('game-container').classList.remove('hidden');
            });
        };

        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
            if (document.hidden && gameState && gameState.running && !gameState.paused) {
                togglePause(true);
            }
        });

        if ('serviceWorker' in navigator && location.protocol.indexOf('http') === 0) {
            navigator.serviceWorker.register('./service-worker.js').catch(() => { });
        }

        function initGame(diffKey) {
            if (gameState && gameState.running) return;
            document.getElementById('start-screen').classList.add('fade-out');
            document.getElementById('game-over-screen').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('pause-overlay').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('ui-layer').classList.remove('hidden');

            currentDifficulty = diffKey;
            currentConfig = DIFFICULTY_SETTINGS[diffKey] || DIFFICULTY_SETTINGS['normal'];

            let badge = document.getElementById('diff-badge');
            badge.innerText = currentConfig.name;
            badge.style.backgroundColor = currentConfig.color;

            gameState = {
                running: true,
                paused: false,
                worldProgress: 0,
                screenShake: 0,
                ageTransition: 0,
                player: { hp: 500, maxHp: 500, age: 0, gold: 175, xp: 0, turrets: [null, null, null, null], turretProgress: [1, 1, 1, 1], unlockedSlots: 1, specialTimer: 0, drawProgress: 1, upgrades: { dmg: 0, hp: 0, econ: 0 } },
                enemy: { hp: 500 * currentConfig.baseHpMult, maxHp: 500 * currentConfig.baseHpMult, age: 0, gold: currentConfig.baseGold, xp: 0, turrets: [null, null, null, null], turretProgress: [1, 1, 1, 1], unlockedSlots: 1, aiTimer: 2, specialTimer: 0, drawProgress: 1, upgrades: { dmg: 0, hp: 0, econ: 0 } },
                specialActive: null,

                // Vast Object Pools to handle "Impossible" stress
                units: new ObjectPool(600, () => ({})),
                projectiles: new ObjectPool(1000, () => ({ trailX: new Float32Array(10), trailY: new Float32Array(10) })),
                particles: new ObjectPool(2500, () => ({})),
                visualFx: new ObjectPool(50, () => ({})),
                floatingTexts: new ObjectPool(200, () => ({}))
            };

            applyTheme(0);
            accumulator = 0;
            globalTime = 0;
            globalIdSequence = 0;
            lastTime = performance.now();
            switchTab('units');
            AIDirector.start(diffKey);
            requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
        }

        function applyTheme(ageIndex) {
            let theme = AGES[ageIndex].theme;
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--background', theme.bg);
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--foreground', theme.fg);
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--pencil', theme.fg);
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--accent', theme.accent);

            COLORS.pencil = `hsl(${theme.fg})`;
            COLORS.pencilLight = `hsl(${theme.fg} / 0.5)`;
            COLORS.accent = `hsl(${theme.accent})`;
        }

        // --- CORE FIXED-TIMESTEP LOOP ---
        function gameLoop(timestamp) {
            if (!gameState.running) return;
            if (gameState.paused) {
                lastTime = timestamp;
                draw();
                requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
                return;
            }

            // Safety cap for massive lag spikes
            let frameTime = Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.25);
            lastTime = timestamp;
            accumulator += frameTime;

            while (accumulator >= FIXED_DT) {
                update(FIXED_DT);
                globalTime += FIXED_DT;
                accumulator -= FIXED_DT;
            }

            draw();
            requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
        }

        function getStatMult(state, type) {
            let isEnemy = state === gameState.enemy;
            let base = 1.0;

            if (type === 'dmg') base = 1.0 + (state.upgrades.dmg * 0.15);
            if (type === 'hp') base = 1.0 + (state.upgrades.hp * 0.25);
            if (type === 'econ') base = 1.0 + (state.upgrades.econ * 0.20);

            if (isEnemy) {
                if (type === 'dmg') return base * currentConfig.dmgMult;
                if (type === 'hp') return base * currentConfig.hpMult;
                if (type === 'econ') return base * currentConfig.econMult;
            }
            return base;
        }

        function insertionSortQueueDesc(arr, count) {
            for (let i = 1; i < count; i++) {
                let key = arr[i]; let j = i - 1;
                while (j >= 0 && arr[j].x < key.x) { arr[j + 1] = arr[j]; j--; }
                arr[j + 1] = key;
            }
        }

        function insertionSortQueueAsc(arr, count) {
            for (let i = 1; i < count; i++) {
                let key = arr[i]; let j = i - 1;
                while (j >= 0 && arr[j].x > key.x) { arr[j + 1] = arr[j]; j--; }
                arr[j + 1] = key;
            }
        }

        // --- UPDATE LOGIC ---
        function update(dt) {
            if (gameState.worldProgress < 1.0) {
                gameState.worldProgress += dt * 0.75;
                if (gameState.worldProgress > 1.0) gameState.worldProgress = 1.0;
                else return;
            }

            if (gameState.ageTransition > 0) gameState.ageTransition -= dt;

            gameState.player.gold += (5 + gameState.player.age * 5) * getStatMult(gameState.player, 'econ') * dt;
            gameState.enemy.gold += (5 + gameState.enemy.age * 5) * getStatMult(gameState.enemy, 'econ') * dt;

            if (gameState.player.specialTimer > 0) {
                gameState.player.specialTimer -= dt;
                if (gameState.player.specialTimer <= 0 && currentTab === 'units') {
                    document.getElementById('btn-special').classList.add('pulse-alert');
                    setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('btn-special').classList.remove('pulse-alert'), 3000);
                }
            }
            if (gameState.enemy.specialTimer > 0) gameState.enemy.specialTimer -= dt;
            if (gameState.screenShake > 0) gameState.screenShake -= dt;

            if (gameState.player.drawProgress < 1) gameState.player.drawProgress += dt * 0.3;
            if (gameState.enemy.drawProgress < 1) gameState.enemy.drawProgress += dt * 0.3;

            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                if (gameState.player.turretProgress[i] < 1) gameState.player.turretProgress[i] += dt * 0.5;
                if (gameState.enemy.turretProgress[i] < 1) gameState.enemy.turretProgress[i] += dt * 0.5;
            }

            handleAdvancedAI(dt);
            handleSpecialAttacks(dt);

            physicsAlliesCount = 0;
            physicsEnemiesCount = 0;

            for (let i = 0; i < gameState.units.pool.length; i++) {
                let u = gameState.units.pool[i];
                if (!u.active) continue;

                if (u.team === 1) physicsAllies[physicsAlliesCount++] = u;
                else physicsEnemies[physicsEnemiesCount++] = u;

                if (u.hp <= 0) {
                    if (u.team === -1) {
                        gameState.player.gold += u.killGold;
                        addXP(1, u.killXp);
                        spawnCanvasText(`+${u.killGold}g`, u.x, u.y - u.size - 20, COLORS.gold);
                    } else {
                        gameState.enemy.gold += u.killGold * currentConfig.econMult;
                        addXP(-1, u.killXp);
                    }
                    spawnParticles(u.x, u.y - u.size / 2, COLORS.destructive, 10, 'splatter');
                    spawnParticles(u.x, u.y - u.size, COLORS.pencilLight, 1, 'ghost');

                    u.active = false;
                    if (u.team === 1) physicsAlliesCount--; else physicsEnemiesCount--;
                }
            }

            insertionSortQueueDesc(physicsAllies, physicsAlliesCount);
            insertionSortQueueAsc(physicsEnemies, physicsEnemiesCount);

            resolveQueueLogic(physicsAllies, physicsAlliesCount, physicsEnemies, physicsEnemiesCount, 1, CANVAS_WIDTH - BASE_WIDTH, dt);
            resolveQueueLogic(physicsEnemies, physicsEnemiesCount, physicsAllies, physicsAlliesCount, -1, BASE_WIDTH, dt);

            updateTurrets(1, physicsEnemies, physicsEnemiesCount, dt);
            updateTurrets(-1, physicsAllies, physicsAlliesCount, dt);

            updateProjectilesAndFX(dt);
            updateUI();
            checkWinLoss();
        }

        function resolveQueueLogic(allies, aCount, enemies, eCount, dir, enemyBaseX, dt) {
            let queueLimit = dir === 1 ? CANVAS_WIDTH : 0;

            for (let i = 0; i < aCount; i++) {
                let u = allies[i];

                if (u.drawProgress < 1.0) {
                    u.drawProgress += dt * 2.0;
                    if (Math.random() < 0.4) spawnParticles(u.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * u.size, u.y - Math.random() * u.size, COLORS.pencil, 1, 'graphite');
                    queueLimit = u.x - dir * (u.size / 2 + 5);
                    continue;
                }

                if (u.attackCooldown > 0) u.attackCooldown -= dt;
                if (u.animTimer > 0) u.animTimer -= dt;

                let target = null;
                let minDist = Infinity;
                for (let j = 0; j < eCount; j++) {
                    let e = enemies[j];
                    if (e.drawProgress < 0.8 || e.hp <= 0) continue;
                    let dist = (e.x - u.x) * dir - (u.size / 2 + e.size / 2);
                    if (dist >= 0 && dist < minDist) { minDist = dist; target = e; }
                }

                let baseDist = (enemyBaseX - u.x) * dir - u.size / 2;
                let targetIsBase = false;
                if (baseDist < minDist && baseDist >= 0) { minDist = baseDist; targetIsBase = true; }

                if (minDist <= u.range) {
                    u.isAttacking = true;
                    u.moving = false;
                    queueLimit = u.x - dir * (u.size / 2 + 5);

                    if (u.attackCooldown <= 0) {
                        u.attackCooldown = u.attackSpeed;
                        u.animTimer = 0.3;
                        let actualDmg = u.dmg * getStatMult(u.team === 1 ? gameState.player : gameState.enemy, 'dmg');
                        let tX = targetIsBase ? enemyBaseX : target.x;
                        let tY = targetIsBase ? GROUND_Y - 40 : target.y - target.size / 2;

                        if (u.projType) {
                            fireProjectile(u.x, u.y - u.size * 0.7, tX, tY, u.projType, u.projSpeed, actualDmg, u.team, target);
                        } else {
                            spawnParticles(u.x + dir * u.size / 2, u.y - u.size / 2, COLORS.pencil, 1, 'slash');
                            if (targetIsBase) {
                                applyDamage(u.team === 1 ? -1 : 1, 'base', actualDmg);
                            } else if (target && target.hp > 0) {
                                target.hp -= actualDmg;
                                spawnParticles(target.x, target.y - target.size / 2, COLORS.destructive, 5, 'splatter');
                                spawnCanvasText(`-${Math.floor(actualDmg)}`, target.x + (Math.random() * 20 - 10), target.y - target.size, COLORS.destructive);
                                if (u.type === 'heavy') target.x += dir * 15;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    u.isAttacking = false;
                    u.moving = true;
                    let intendedX = u.x + u.speed * dir * dt;
                    let blockedX = queueLimit - dir * (u.size / 2 + 5);

                    // Ensure base bounds are not exceeded
                    if (dir === 1 && blockedX > enemyBaseX) blockedX = enemyBaseX;
                    if (dir === -1 && blockedX < enemyBaseX) blockedX = enemyBaseX;

                    if ((dir === 1 && intendedX > blockedX) || (dir === -1 && intendedX < blockedX)) {
                        u.x += (blockedX - u.x) * 10 * dt;
                        if (Math.abs(u.x - blockedX) < 2) u.moving = false;
                    } else {
                        u.x = intendedX;
                    }
                    queueLimit = u.x - dir * (u.size / 2 + 5);
                }
            }
        }

        function updateProjectilesAndFX(dt) {
            for (let i = 0; i < gameState.projectiles.pool.length; i++) {
                let p = gameState.projectiles.pool[i];
                if (!p.active) continue;

                let validTarget = p.targetUnit && p.targetUnit.active && p.targetUnit.id === p.targetUnitId;

                if (p.type === 'laser' || p.type === 'orbital') {
                    p.life -= dt;
                    if (p.life <= 0) p.active = false;
                    else if (!p.isSpecial && !p.hit) {
                        if (validTarget && p.targetUnit.hp > 0) p.targetUnit.hp -= p.dmg;
                        else if (p.targetIsBase) applyDamage(p.team === 1 ? -1 : 1, 'base', p.dmg);
                        p.hit = true;
                        spawnParticles(p.targetX, p.targetY, COLORS.blue, 10, 'spark');
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                if (p.type === 'bombDrop') {
                    p.vy += 800 * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
                    if (p.y > GROUND_Y) {
                        applyAoEDamage(p.x, p.team, p.dmg, 120, true);
                        spawnParticles(p.x, GROUND_Y, COLORS.fire, 20, 'explosion');
                        gameState.screenShake = 0.2; p.active = false;
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                for (let j = 9; j > 0; j--) {
                    p.trailX[j] = p.trailX[j - 1]; p.trailY[j] = p.trailY[j - 1];
                }
                p.trailX[0] = p.x; p.trailY[0] = p.y;
                p.trailCount = Math.min(10, (p.trailCount || 0) + 1);

                p.x += p.vx * dt;
                p.y += p.vy * dt;

                if (p.type === 'arc' || p.type === 'meteor' || p.type === 'arrow' || p.type === 'cannonball') p.vy += 800 * dt;
                if (p.type === 'orb') { p.life += dt; p.vx += Math.sin(p.life * 10) * 50 * dt; }

                let hit = false;
                if (p.y >= p.targetY && Math.abs(p.x - p.targetX) < HIT_TOLERANCE) hit = true;
                if (p.y > GROUND_Y + 20) hit = true;
                if ((p.team === 1 && p.x >= CANVAS_WIDTH - BASE_WIDTH) || (p.team === -1 && p.x <= BASE_WIDTH)) hit = true;

                if (validTarget && (p.type === 'straight' || p.type === 'orb')) {
                    let dx = p.targetUnit.x - p.x; let dy = (p.targetUnit.y - p.targetUnit.size / 2) - p.y;
                    if (Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) < p.targetUnit.size / 2) hit = true;
                }

                if (hit) {
                    if (p.isSpecial) {
                        let radius = p.type === 'meteor' ? 150 : (p.type === 'cannonball' ? 120 : 60);
                        applyAoEDamage(p.x, p.team, p.dmg, radius, true);
                        if (p.type === 'meteor' || p.type === 'cannonball') {
                            spawnParticles(p.x, GROUND_Y, COLORS.fire, 25, 'explosion');
                            spawnParticles(p.x, GROUND_Y, COLORS.pencil, 15, 'dust');
                            gameState.screenShake = p.type === 'meteor' ? 0.3 : 0.2;
                        } else if (p.type === 'arrow') {
                            spawnParticles(p.x, GROUND_Y, COLORS.pencilLight, 5, 'dust');
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (validTarget && Math.abs(p.x - p.targetUnit.x) < p.targetUnit.size + 20) {
                            p.targetUnit.hp -= p.dmg;
                            spawnParticles(p.x, p.y, COLORS.destructive, 5, 'splatter');
                            spawnCanvasText(`-${Math.floor(p.dmg)}`, p.x, p.y - 20, COLORS.destructive);
                        } else if (
                            (p.team === 1 && p.x >= CANVAS_WIDTH - BASE_WIDTH - HIT_TOLERANCE) ||
                            (p.team === -1 && p.x <= BASE_WIDTH + HIT_TOLERANCE)
                        ) {
                            applyDamage(p.team === 1 ? -1 : 1, 'base', p.dmg);
                            spawnParticles(p.x, p.y, COLORS.accent, 8, 'explosion');
                        } else {
                            spawnParticles(p.x, GROUND_Y, COLORS.pencilLight, 5, 'dust');
                        }
                    }
                    p.active = false;
                }
            }

            for (let i = 0; i < gameState.visualFx.pool.length; i++) {
                let fx = gameState.visualFx.pool[i];
                if (!fx.active) continue;
                if (fx.type === 'plane') {
                    fx.x += fx.vx * dt;
                    if (Math.random() < dt * 4) {
                        gameState.projectiles.spawn({ type: 'bombDrop', x: fx.x, y: fx.y, vx: 0, vy: 0, dmg: 400, team: fx.team, isSpecial: true });
                    }
                    if ((fx.vx > 0 && fx.x > CANVAS_WIDTH) || (fx.vx < 0 && fx.x < 0)) fx.active = false;
                }
            }

            for (let i = 0; i < gameState.particles.pool.length; i++) {
                let pt = gameState.particles.pool[i];
                if (!pt.active) continue;

                pt.x += pt.vx * dt;
                pt.y += pt.vy * dt;

                if (['splatter', 'explosion', 'dust'].includes(pt.pType)) pt.vy += 600 * dt;
                if (pt.pType === 'graphite' || pt.pType === 'ghost') {
                    pt.x += Math.sin(pt.life * 10) * 15 * dt;
                    pt.y -= 30 * dt;
                }

                pt.life -= dt;
                if (pt.life <= 0) pt.active = false;
            }

            for (let i = 0; i < gameState.floatingTexts.pool.length; i++) {
                let ft = gameState.floatingTexts.pool[i];
                if (!ft.active) continue;
                ft.life -= dt * 1.2;
                ft.y -= dt * 40;
                if (ft.life <= 0) ft.active = false;
            }
        }

        function updateTurrets(team, enemies, eCount, dt) {
            let state = team === 1 ? gameState.player : gameState.enemy;
            for (let i = 0; i < state.unlockedSlots; i++) {
                let tIdx = state.turrets[i];
                if (tIdx === null || state.turretProgress[i] < 1) continue;

                if (!state.turretTimers) state.turretTimers = [0, 0, 0, 0];
                state.turretTimers[i] -= dt;

                if (state.turretTimers[i] <= 0) {
                    let tData = AGES[state.age].turrets[tIdx];
                    let baseX = team === 1 ? BASE_WIDTH - 10 : CANVAS_WIDTH - BASE_WIDTH + 10;
                    let baseY = GROUND_Y - 150 - (i * 90);
                    let actualDmg = tData.dmg * getStatMult(state, 'dmg');

                    let target = null, closest = Infinity;
                    for (let j = 0; j < eCount; j++) {
                        let e = enemies[j];
                        if (e.drawProgress < 0.8 || e.hp <= 0) continue;
                        let dist = Math.abs(e.x - baseX);
                        if (dist <= tData.range && dist < closest) { closest = dist; target = e; }
                    }
                    if (target) {
                        state.turretTimers[i] = tData.attackSpeed;
                        spawnParticles(baseX + (team * 20), baseY, COLORS.pencil, 3, 'spark');
                        fireProjectile(baseX, baseY, target.x, target.y - target.size / 2, tData.projType, tData.projSpeed, actualDmg, team, target);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // --- ADVANCED AI DECISION ENGINE ---
        function handleAdvancedAI(dt) {
            AIDirector.tick(dt);
        }

        function handleSpecialAttacks(dt) {
            if (!gameState.specialActive) return;

            let sa = gameState.specialActive;
            sa.timer -= dt;
            let sData = AGES[sa.age].special;
            let effectArea = (sa.team === 1) ? { min: BASE_WIDTH + 50, max: CANVAS_WIDTH } : { min: 0, max: CANVAS_WIDTH - BASE_WIDTH - 50 };

            if (sData.type === "meteor") {
                if (Math.random() < 8 * dt) {
                    let sx = effectArea.min + Math.random() * (effectArea.max - effectArea.min);
                    fireProjectile(sx - (sa.team * 200), -50, sx, GROUND_Y, 'meteor', 800, 150, sa.team, null);
                }
            } else if (sData.type === "arrows") {
                if (Math.random() < 30 * dt) {
                    let sx = effectArea.min + Math.random() * (effectArea.max - effectArea.min);
                    fireProjectile(sx - (sa.team * 300), -50, sx, GROUND_Y, 'arrow', 1000, 40, sa.team, null);
                }
            } else if (sData.type === "cannons") {
                if (Math.random() < 6 * dt) {
                    let sx = effectArea.min + Math.random() * (effectArea.max - effectArea.min);
                    let startX = sa.team === 1 ? 0 : CANVAS_WIDTH;
                    fireProjectile(startX, Math.random() * 200 + 100, sx, GROUND_Y, 'cannonball', 1200, 300, sa.team, null);
                }
            } else if (sData.type === "airstrike") {
                let planeCount = 0;
                for (let i = 0; i < gameState.visualFx.pool.length; i++) {
                    if (gameState.visualFx.pool[i].active && gameState.visualFx.pool[i].type === 'plane') planeCount++;
                }
                if (Math.random() < 2 * dt && planeCount < 2) {
                    gameState.visualFx.spawn({
                        type: 'plane', x: sa.team === 1 ? 0 : CANVAS_WIDTH,
                        y: 150 + Math.random() * 100, vx: sa.team === 1 ? 600 : -600, team: sa.team
                    });
                }
            } else if (sData.type === "laser" || sData.type === "orbital") {
                gameState.screenShake = sData.type === "laser" ? 0.15 : 0.3;
                let dpt = (sData.type === "laser" ? 800 : 2500) * dt;
                let cx = sa.team === 1 ? effectArea.max - 300 : effectArea.min + 300;

                let found = false;
                for (let i = 0; i < gameState.projectiles.pool.length; i++) {
                    if (gameState.projectiles.pool[i].active && gameState.projectiles.pool[i].type === sData.type && gameState.projectiles.pool[i].team === sa.team) { found = true; break; }
                }
                if (!found) gameState.projectiles.spawn({ type: sData.type, x: cx, y: GROUND_Y, life: sa.timer, team: sa.team, isSpecial: true });

                let radius = sData.type === "laser" ? 150 : 300;
                for (let i = 0; i < gameState.units.pool.length; i++) {
                    let e = gameState.units.pool[i];
                    if (!e.active || e.team === sa.team) continue;
                    if (Math.abs(e.x - cx) < radius) {
                        e.hp -= dpt;
                        if (Math.random() < 0.2) spawnParticles(e.x, e.y - e.size / 2, COLORS.destructive, 1, 'splatter');
                    }
                }
            }
            if (sa.timer <= 0) gameState.specialActive = null;
        }

        // --- ACTIONS & UTILS ---
        function fireProjectile(startX, startY, targetX, targetY, type, speed, dmg, team, targetUnit) {
            let dx = targetX - startX;
            let dy = targetY - startY;
            let isSpecial = ['meteor', 'arrow', 'cannonball', 'bombDrop'].includes(type);

            let p = gameState.projectiles.spawn({
                x: startX, y: startY, targetX, targetY, type, speed, dmg, team,
                targetUnit: targetUnit, targetUnitId: targetUnit ? targetUnit.id : null,
                targetIsBase: !targetUnit && ((team === 1 && targetX >= CANVAS_WIDTH - BASE_WIDTH - HIT_TOLERANCE) || (team === -1 && targetX <= BASE_WIDTH + HIT_TOLERANCE)),
                life: 0, hit: false, isSpecial, trailCount: 0
            });

            if (['straight', 'laser', 'orb'].includes(type)) {
                let dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                if (dist < 1) dist = 1;
                p.vx = (dx / dist) * speed; p.vy = (dy / dist) * speed;
                if (type === 'laser') p.life = 0.25;
            } else {
                let t = Math.abs(dx) / speed;
                p.vx = (dx / t); p.vy = (dy - 0.5 * 800 * t * t) / t;
            }
        }

        function applyAoEDamage(x, sourceTeam, dmg, radius, isSpecial = false) {
            for (let i = 0; i < gameState.units.pool.length; i++) {
                let e = gameState.units.pool[i];
                if (!e.active || e.team === sourceTeam) continue;
                if (Math.abs(e.x - x) < radius) {
                    e.hp -= dmg;
                    spawnCanvasText(`-${Math.floor(dmg)}`, e.x, e.y - e.size - 10, COLORS.destructive);
                    e.x += sourceTeam * 10;
                }
            }
            if (!isSpecial) {
                let baseHitX = sourceTeam === 1 ? CANVAS_WIDTH - BASE_WIDTH : BASE_WIDTH;
                if (Math.abs(baseHitX - x) < radius) applyDamage(sourceTeam === 1 ? -1 : 1, 'base', dmg);
            }
        }

        function switchTab(tab) {
            currentTab = tab;
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            document.getElementById(`tab-${tab}`).classList.add('active');
            UIManager.toggleClass('menuUnits', tab !== 'units', 'hidden');
            UIManager.toggleClass('menuTurrets', tab !== 'turrets', 'hidden');
            UIManager.toggleClass('menuUpgrades', tab !== 'upgrades', 'hidden');
            updateUI();
        }

        function buyUnit(typeIdx) {
            let p = gameState.player;
            let cost = AGES[p.age].units[typeIdx].cost;
            if (p.gold >= cost && p.drawProgress >= 1) {
                p.gold -= cost;
                spawnUnit(1, p.age, typeIdx);
                updateUI();
            }
        }

        function buyTurret(typeIdx) {
            let p = gameState.player;
            let cost = AGES[p.age].turrets[typeIdx].cost;
            let emptySlot = p.turrets.findIndex((t, idx) => t === null && idx < p.unlockedSlots);
            if (p.gold >= cost && emptySlot !== -1 && p.drawProgress >= 1) {
                p.gold -= cost; p.turrets[emptySlot] = typeIdx; p.turretProgress[emptySlot] = 0; updateUI();
            }
        }

        function sellTurret() {
            let p = gameState.player;
            for (let i = p.unlockedSlots - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (p.turrets[i] !== null) {
                    p.gold += AGES[p.age].turrets[p.turrets[i]].cost * 0.5; p.turrets[i] = null; updateUI(); break;
                }
            }
        }

        function buySlot() {
            let p = gameState.player; let cost = p.unlockedSlots * 500;
            if (p.unlockedSlots < 4 && p.gold >= cost) { p.gold -= cost; p.unlockedSlots++; updateUI(); }
        }

        function buyUpgrade(type) {
            let p = gameState.player; let lvl = p.upgrades[type];
            if (lvl < 10 && p.gold >= UPGRADE_COSTS[lvl]) {
                p.gold -= UPGRADE_COSTS[lvl]; p.upgrades[type]++;
                if (type === 'hp') {
                    let newMax = AGES[p.age].baseHp * getStatMult(p, 'hp');
                    p.hp += (newMax - p.maxHp); p.maxHp = newMax;
                }
                spawnCanvasText("UPGRADED!", BASE_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT / 2, COLORS.accent);
                updateUI();
            }
        }

        function evolve() {
            let p = gameState.player;
            if (p.age < AGES.length - 1 && p.xp >= AGES[p.age].evolveXP && p.drawProgress >= 1) {
                p.age++; p.drawProgress = 0;
                let newMax = AGES[p.age].baseHp * getStatMult(p, 'hp');
                p.hp += (newMax - p.maxHp); p.maxHp = newMax;
                p.turrets = [null, null, null, null];

                applyTheme(p.age);
                gameState.ageTransition = 1.0;
                spawnCanvasText("NEW AGE!", BASE_WIDTH + 50, CANVAS_HEIGHT / 2, COLORS.gold);
                gameState.screenShake = 0.5;
                updateUI();
            }
        }

        function useSpecial() {
            let p = gameState.player;
            if (p.specialTimer <= 0 && !gameState.specialActive) {
                triggerSpecial(1); p.specialTimer = AGES[p.age].special.cooldown; updateUI();
            }
        }

        function triggerSpecial(team) {
            let age = team === 1 ? gameState.player.age : gameState.enemy.age;
            gameState.specialActive = { team, age, timer: AGES[age].special.duration };
        }

        function spawnUnit(team, age, typeIdx) {
            let uData = AGES[age].units[typeIdx];
            let owner = team === 1 ? gameState.player : gameState.enemy;
            let hp = uData.hp * getStatMult(owner, 'hp');
            gameState.units.spawn({
                id: ++globalIdSequence, team: team, age: age, uType: typeIdx, type: uData.type, name: uData.name,
                x: team === 1 ? BASE_WIDTH : CANVAS_WIDTH - BASE_WIDTH, y: GROUND_Y,
                hp: hp, maxHp: hp, dmg: uData.dmg, range: uData.range,
                speed: uData.speed, size: uData.size, attackSpeed: uData.attackSpeed,
                projType: uData.projType, projSpeed: uData.projSpeed,
                killXp: uData.killXp, killGold: uData.killGold,
                attackCooldown: 0, animOffset: Math.random() * 100,
                isAttacking: false, moving: true, animTimer: 0, drawProgress: 0
            });
        }

        function applyDamage(targetTeam, targetType, amount) {
            if (targetType === 'base' && amount > 0) {
                let state = targetTeam === 1 ? gameState.player : gameState.enemy;
                state.hp -= amount;
                let bx = targetTeam === 1 ? BASE_WIDTH / 2 : CANVAS_WIDTH - BASE_WIDTH / 2;
                spawnParticles(bx, GROUND_Y - 100, COLORS.destructive, 15, 'explosion');
                spawnCanvasText(`-${Math.floor(amount)}`, bx, GROUND_Y - 150, COLORS.destructive);
                if (amount > 100) gameState.screenShake = 0.1;
            }
        }

        function addXP(team, amount) {
            if (team === 1) {
                gameState.player.xp += amount;
                spawnCanvasText(`+${amount} XP`, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 200, COLORS.blue);
            } else {
                gameState.enemy.xp += amount * currentConfig.xpMult;
            }
        }

        function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count, pType) {
            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                gameState.particles.spawn({
                    x, y, pType, color,
                    vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 500, vy: (Math.random() - 1) * 400,
                    life: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.5, size: Math.random() * 8 + 4
                });
            }
        }

        function spawnCanvasText(text, x, y, color) {
            gameState.floatingTexts.spawn({ text, x, y, color, life: 1.0 });
        }

        function updateUI() {
            if (!gameState.player) return;
            let p = gameState.player;
            let ageData = AGES[p.age];

            UIManager.setText('ui-gold', Math.floor(p.gold));
            UIManager.setText('ui-xp', Math.floor(p.xp));
            UIManager.setText('ui-income', ((5 + p.age * 5) * getStatMult(p, 'econ')).toFixed(1) + "/s");
            UIManager.setText('age-title', ageData.name);

            if (currentTab === 'units') {
                for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                    let uData = ageData.units[i];
                    UIManager.setText(`name-u${i + 1}`, uData.name);
                    UIManager.setText(`cost-u${i + 1}`, uData.cost);
                    UIManager.setDisabled(`btn-u${i + 1}`, p.gold < uData.cost || p.drawProgress < 1);
                }
            } else if (currentTab === 'turrets') {
                let hasEmptySlot = p.turrets.slice(0, p.unlockedSlots).includes(null);
                let hasTurret = p.turrets.some(t => t !== null);
                for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                    let tData = ageData.turrets[i];
                    UIManager.setText(`name-t${i + 1}`, tData.name);
                    UIManager.setText(`cost-t${i + 1}`, tData.cost);
                    UIManager.setDisabled(`btn-t${i + 1}`, p.gold < tData.cost || !hasEmptySlot || p.drawProgress < 1);
                }
                UIManager.setDisabled('btn-sell', !hasTurret);

                if (p.unlockedSlots >= 4) {
                    UIManager.setDisabled('btn-slot', true); UIManager.setText('cost-slot', "MAX");
                } else {
                    let slotCost = p.unlockedSlots * 500;
                    UIManager.setText('cost-slot', slotCost); UIManager.setDisabled('btn-slot', p.gold < slotCost);
                }
            } else if (currentTab === 'upgrades') {
                ['dmg', 'hp', 'econ'].forEach(t => {
                    let lvl = p.upgrades[t];
                    if (lvl >= 10) {
                        UIManager.setDisabled(`btn-up-${t}`, true); UIManager.setText(`cost-up-${t}`, "MAX"); UIManager.setText(`val-up-${t}`, `Lvl 10`);
                    } else {
                        let cost = UPGRADE_COSTS[lvl];
                        UIManager.setText(`cost-up-${t}`, cost); UIManager.setDisabled(`btn-up-${t}`, p.gold < cost);
                        let mult = (t === 'dmg') ? 15 : (t === 'hp' ? 25 : 20);
                        UIManager.setText(`val-up-${t}`, `Lvl ${lvl} (+${lvl * mult}%)`);
                    }
                });
            }

            if (p.age >= AGES.length - 1) {
                UIManager.setDisabled('btn-evolve', true); UIManager.setText('cost-evolve', "MAX AGE");
            } else {
                UIManager.setText('cost-evolve', ageData.evolveXP + " XP");
                UIManager.setDisabled('btn-evolve', p.xp < ageData.evolveXP || p.drawProgress < 1);
            }

            if (p.specialTimer > 0) {
                UIManager.setDisabled('btn-special', true); UIManager.setText('cost-special', Math.ceil(p.specialTimer) + "s");
            } else if (gameState.specialActive) {
                UIManager.setDisabled('btn-special', true); UIManager.setText('cost-special', "Busy");
            } else {
                UIManager.setDisabled('btn-special', false); UIManager.setText('cost-special', "Ready");
            }

            UIManager.setWidth('player-hp-fill', `${Math.max(0, p.hp / p.maxHp) * 100}%`);
            UIManager.setWidth('enemy-hp-fill', `${Math.max(0, gameState.enemy.hp / gameState.enemy.maxHp) * 100}%`);
            UIManager.setText('player-hp-text', `${Math.floor(Math.max(0, p.hp))} / ${Math.floor(p.maxHp)}`);
            UIManager.setText('enemy-hp-text', `${Math.floor(Math.max(0, gameState.enemy.hp))} / ${Math.floor(gameState.enemy.maxHp)}`);
        }

        function checkWinLoss() {
            if (gameState.player.hp <= 0 || gameState.enemy.hp <= 0) {
                gameState.running = false;
                document.getElementById('game-over-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
                TooltipManager.hide();

                let won = gameState.enemy.hp <= 0;
                document.getElementById('end-title').innerText = won ? "Victory!" : "Defeat...";
                document.getElementById('end-desc').innerText = won ? "You have conquered history and filled the sketchbook." : "Your civilization was erased from the pages of history.";

                if (won) {
                    StorageManager.saveWin(currentDifficulty);
                    DirectorPanel.add('ai', 'That page is yours. I saved the difficulty medal.');
                    GemmaMemory.recordSystem(`Match ended: player won ${currentDifficulty} at ${Math.round(globalTime)}s.`);
                } else {
                    DirectorPanel.add('ai', 'I took this page. The pacts and memory remain for the rematch.');
                    GemmaMemory.recordSystem(`Match ended: Gemma director won ${currentDifficulty} at ${Math.round(globalTime)}s.`);
                }
            }
        }

        // --- RENDERING PIPELINE ---
        function draw() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);
            ctx.save();

            if (gameState.screenShake > 0) {
                let mag = gameState.screenShake * 15;
                ctx.translate(Math.sin(globalTime * 50) * mag, Math.cos(globalTime * 43) * mag);
            }

            drawBackground(gameState.worldProgress);

            if (gameState.worldProgress >= 1.0) {
                drawBase(1, gameState.player);
                drawBase(-1, gameState.enemy);

                for (let i = 0; i < gameState.units.pool.length; i++) {
                    if (gameState.units.pool[i].active) drawUnit(gameState.units.pool[i]);
                }
                for (let i = 0; i < gameState.projectiles.pool.length; i++) {
                    if (gameState.projectiles.pool[i].active) drawProjectile(gameState.projectiles.pool[i]);
                }
                for (let i = 0; i < gameState.visualFx.pool.length; i++) {
                    if (gameState.visualFx.pool[i].active) drawFX(gameState.visualFx.pool[i]);
                }

                // Render Particles
                for (let i = 0; i < gameState.particles.pool.length; i++) {
                    let pt = gameState.particles.pool[i];
                    if (!pt.active) continue;

                    setSketchStyle(pt.color, 2);
                    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, pt.life);

                    if (pt.pType === 'splatter') {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(pt.x, pt.y);
                        ctx.lineTo(pt.x - pt.vx * 0.05, pt.y - pt.vy * 0.05);
                        ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, pt.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fill();
                    } else if (pt.pType === 'ghost') {
                        setSketchStyle(COLORS.pencilLight, 2);
                        drawRoughCircle(pt.x, pt.y, 15, 1, 2);
                        drawRoughLine(pt.x - 5, pt.y - 2, pt.x - 2, pt.y - 2, 1, 0);
                        drawRoughLine(pt.x + 5, pt.y - 2, pt.x + 2, pt.y - 2, 1, 0);
                        drawRoughLine(pt.x - 10, pt.y + 15, pt.x + 10, pt.y + 15, 1, 5);
                    } else if (pt.pType === 'slash') {
                        setSketchStyle(COLORS.pencil, 3);
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, 30, -Math.PI / 4, Math.PI / 4);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    } else if (pt.pType === 'graphite') {
                        setSketchStyle(COLORS.pencil, 3);
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fill();
                    } else if (pt.pType === 'spark' || pt.pType === 'dust') {
                        drawRoughCircle(pt.x, pt.y, pt.size / 2, 1, 1);
                    } else {
                        fillScribble(pt.x, pt.y, pt.size, pt.size, pt.color, 3);
                    }
                }
                ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;

                // Render Floating Text
                for (let i = 0; i < gameState.floatingTexts.pool.length; i++) {
                    let ft = gameState.floatingTexts.pool[i];
                    if (!ft.active) continue;

                    ctx.globalAlpha = ft.life;
                    ctx.fillStyle = ft.color;
                    ctx.font = `bold ${30 + (1 - ft.life) * 15}px 'Caveat', cursive`;
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.fillText(ft.text, ft.x, ft.y);
                }
                ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
            }
            ctx.restore();
        }

        function drawBackground(wp) {
            // 1. Draw Organic Procedural Watercolor Wash (Restored Multiply from Iteration 1)
            ctx.save();
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';

            if (gameState.ageTransition > 0) {
                ctx.globalAlpha = gameState.ageTransition;
                ctx.drawImage(WatercolorEngine.canvases[gameState.player.age - 1], 0, 0);
                ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0 - gameState.ageTransition;
                ctx.drawImage(WatercolorEngine.canvases[gameState.player.age], 0, 0);
            } else {
                ctx.drawImage(WatercolorEngine.canvases[gameState.player.age], 0, 0);
            }
            ctx.restore();

            // 2. Era-Specific Architectural/Sketch details
            setSketchStyle(COLORS.pencilLight, 1);
            ctx.save();
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.2 + (0.1 * Math.sin(globalTime));
            let age = gameState.player.age;

            if (age === 0) {
                drawRoughCircle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 200, 50, 1, 5, wp);
                for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) drawRoughCircle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 200, 30 + i * 10, 1, 3, wp);
            } else if (age === 1) {
                for (let x = 200; x < CANVAS_WIDTH - 200; x += 150) {
                    drawRoughLine(x, GROUND_Y, x, GROUND_Y - 300, 1, 1, wp);
                    drawRoughLine(x, GROUND_Y - 300, x + 150, GROUND_Y - 300, 1, 1, wp);
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(x + 75, GROUND_Y - 150, 75, Math.PI, 0);
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
            } else if (age === 2) {
                drawRoughCircle(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 300, 200, 2, 1, wp);
                drawRoughLine(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - 200, 300, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 + 200, 300, 1, 1, wp);
                drawRoughLine(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 100, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 500, 1, 1, wp);
                ctx.strokeRect(CANVAS_WIDTH / 2 - 140, 160, 280, 280);
            } else if (age === 3) {
                for (let r = 0; r < 4; r++) {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    for (let x = 0; x <= CANVAS_WIDTH; x += 100) {
                        let y = 300 + Math.sin(x / 200) * 100 + r * 50 + Math.cos(x / 150 + r) * 30;
                        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
                    }
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
            } else if (age === 4) {
                for (let x = 100; x < CANVAS_WIDTH; x += 150) {
                    for (let y = 100; y < GROUND_Y; y += 130) {
                        drawRoughCircle(x, y, 40, 1, 1, wp);
                        drawRoughLine(x, y, x + 75, y + 65, 1, 1, wp);
                    }
                }
            } else if (age === 5) {
                for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
                    let cx = (Math.sin(i * 12.2) * CANVAS_WIDTH + CANVAS_WIDTH) % CANVAS_WIDTH;
                    let cy = (Math.cos(i * 3.1) * 400 + 400) % 400;
                    drawRoughCircle(cx, cy, 20 + i * 2, 1, 2, wp);
                    drawRoughLine(cx, cy, CANVAS_WIDTH / 2, 200, 1, 1, wp);
                }
            }
            ctx.restore();

            // 3. Environment Scenery
            drawRoughCircle(CANVAS_WIDTH * 0.8, 150, 60, 2, 5, wp);

            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let x = 0; x <= CANVAS_WIDTH; x += 80) {
                let y = GROUND_Y - 200 - Math.sin(x / 300 + globalTime * 0.1) * 100 + jitterVal(x, 0, 5);
                ctx.lineTo(x, y);
            }
            applyDash(wp, CANVAS_WIDTH * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);

            for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
                let cx = (globalTime * 5 + c * 300) % (CANVAS_WIDTH + 200) - 100;
                let cy = 100 + c * 40;
                drawRoughCircle(cx, cy, 30, 1, 5, wp);
                drawRoughCircle(cx + 40, cy - 10, 45, 1, 5, wp);
                drawRoughCircle(cx + 80, cy, 25, 1, 5, wp);
            }

            setSketchStyle(COLORS.pencil, 2);
            drawRoughLine(0, GROUND_Y, CANVAS_WIDTH, GROUND_Y, 2, 5, wp);

            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let i = 0; i < CANVAS_WIDTH; i += 60) {
                let j = jitterVal(i, GROUND_Y, 5);
                ctx.moveTo(i, GROUND_Y + j);
                ctx.lineTo(i + 30, GROUND_Y - 50 - Math.abs(j * 5));
                ctx.lineTo(i + 60, GROUND_Y + j);
            }
            applyDash(wp, CANVAS_WIDTH * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
        }

        function drawFX(fx) {
            if (fx.type === 'plane') {
                ctx.save();
                ctx.translate(fx.x, fx.y);
                if (fx.team === -1) ctx.scale(-1, 1);

                setSketchStyle(COLORS.pencil, 3);
                drawRoughLine(-40, 0, 50, 0, 2, 2);
                drawRoughCircle(50, 0, 10, 2, 2);
                drawRoughLine(10, 0, -20, -30, 2, 2);
                drawRoughLine(10, 0, -20, 30, 2, 2);
                drawRoughLine(-40, 0, -50, -15, 2, 2);
                fillScribble(-30, -5, 60, 10, COLORS.pencil, 3);

                ctx.restore();
            }
        }

        function drawBase(team, state) {
            let x = team === 1 ? 0 : CANVAS_WIDTH - BASE_WIDTH;
            let y = GROUND_Y;
            let dp = state.drawProgress;

            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(x, y);
            if (team === -1) {
                ctx.translate(BASE_WIDTH, 0);
                ctx.scale(-1, 1);
            }

            setSketchStyle(COLORS.pencil, 3);

            switch (AGES[state.age].baseStyle) {
                case "cave":
                    drawRoughLine(10, 0, BASE_WIDTH, 0, 2, 5, dp);
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(10, 0);
                    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(BASE_WIDTH / 2, -300, BASE_WIDTH, 0);
                    applyDash(dp, BASE_WIDTH * 2);
                    ctx.stroke();
                    ctx.setLineDash([]);
                    fillScribble(30, -150, BASE_WIDTH - 60, 150, COLORS.pencil, 8, dp);
                    break;
                case "castle":
                    drawRoughLine(20, 0, 20, -200, 2, 3, dp);
                    drawRoughLine(BASE_WIDTH - 20, 0, BASE_WIDTH - 20, -200, 2, 3, dp);
